svg.title: LSTM autoencoder unrolled over 50 steps
svg.desc: Encoder LSTM reads x_1 to x_50, each of shape (batch, 2), passing h and c of shape (batch, 100). Its last hidden state h_50 is the code z of shape (batch, 100). RepeatVector copies z 50 times giving (batch, 50, 100). The decoder LSTM runs over the copies and one shared Dense layer maps each step's (batch, 100) state to (batch, 2), giving (batch, 50, 2).
svg.text: (batch, 50, 100): copy t feeds decoder step t
